acceptance: After a cycle ends with an audit-fail-defer reason, its item carries a route decided by fix_type: console for reintent, deps on a companion console item for pipeline-repair (red tests first)
The route comes from the fix_type of the recorded failure-decision.json, not from the category text
The routed_reason names the cycle, the category and the fix_type
retry-ladder.md and internal-core.md state the fix_type routing table
fix: Design first: amend docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md and docs/architecture/packages/internal-core.md with a fix_type routing table. TDD: a red test with the cycle 1953 fixture (intent-malformed, fix_type reintent) that the item of the ended cycle is routed to the console through the existing route verb path (inbox route-console) with the decision as reason, and a red test that fix_type pipeline-repair adds a deps entry on a companion console item instead. Route through the one existing routing writer; add no new writer and no flag. 100% coverage on changed functions, zero comments.
source: PR #1015 (a defer-or-quarantine audit decline ends the cycle after retro); triage pass 2026-10-20
summary: PR #1015 ends a cycle after retro when the audit decline carries a defer-or-quarantine decision (go/internal/core/reintent_decision.go, auditDeclineDefers; decideAfterRetro returns PhaseEnd with an audit-fail-defer reason). The decision's fix_type (for example reintent or pipeline-repair) is only copied into the routing-decision evidence (reintent_decision.go:43) and the FixType field of go/internal/core/failure_decision.go:17. No Go code routes the inbox item by fix_type. The item of the ended cycle therefore goes back to the same queue and can be picked again for the same failed attempt.
title: The item of a cycle ended by a reintent decision is routed by its fix_type

consumed.resolution: fix/reintent-fix-type-route: the FAIL closeout of a cycle ended by audit-fail-defer routes its committed items by the fix_type of failure-decision.json (cycleoutcome/defer_route.go): reintent -> inbox route-console with a routed_reason naming cycle, category and fix_type; pipeline-repair -> a console companion pipeline-repair-cycle-N and a deps entry on it; neither bumps failure_count
